## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the product path, and fail when the change is reverted
- [ ] Public API changes are recorded in `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt`
- [ ] No reflection or runtime code generation on serialization paths
- [ ] Performance-sensitive change: benchmarks run and compared against Apache.Avro
- [ ] Provenance: this change contains no code copied or ported from Apache.Avro
